content.value_statement: Creating useful Claude Code skills requires clear triggers, focused instructions, and well-organized resources. This skill guides developers through planning, writing, validating, and improving plugin skills.
actual_capabilities: Explains the required SKILL.md structure and frontmatter fields.
Guides developers through planning skills from concrete user examples.
Shows when to use references, examples, scripts, and assets.
Provides validation checklists for trigger quality and writing style.
Describes progressive disclosure patterns for efficient context use.
Includes examples of strong and weak skill descriptions.
limitations: Does not generate plugin code automatically without user direction.
Does not validate skills with a dedicated executable validator.
Focuses on Claude Code plugin skills, not every skill packaging format.
Requires the developer to test real trigger behavior after writing the skill.

use_cases.title: Create a new plugin skill
use_cases.description: Plan the skill purpose, create the directory structure, and write a focused SKILL.md file.

use_cases.title: Improve skill trigger quality
use_cases.description: Rewrite vague descriptions into specific third-person triggers that match real user requests.

use_cases.title: Refactor large skill documentation
use_cases.description: Move detailed material into references, examples, or scripts while keeping core instructions concise.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a basic skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new skill outline.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a Claude Code plugin skill for [task]. Ask for the most important missing details, then draft the skill structure.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a skill description
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this skill description and rewrite it with third-person wording and specific trigger phrases users would say.

prompt_templates.title: Plan reusable resources
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate skill design with scripts and references.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these use cases for my skill, decide which content belongs in SKILL.md, references, examples, scripts, or assets.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a complete skill
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before publishing a plugin skill.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Claude Code plugin skill for trigger quality, progressive disclosure, writing style, resource references, and test coverage.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for helping users write database migration plans.
output_examples.output: A concise skill plan with target triggers, a SKILL.md outline, suggested reference files, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: My skill description says it helps with hooks. Improve it.
output_examples.output: A third-person description with concrete phrases such as creating hooks, adding PreToolUse hooks, and validating hook behavior.

output_examples.input: This SKILL.md is too long. How should I split it?
output: Keep core workflow steps in SKILL.md.
Add scripts only for repeated deterministic tasks.

best_practices: Start from concrete user requests before designing the skill contents.
Keep SKILL.md focused and move detailed material into referenced resources.
Use specific third-person trigger descriptions and imperative body instructions.
anti_patterns: Using vague descriptions that do not match real user phrases.
Putting all detailed documentation into SKILL.md instead of using references.
Adding example files or scripts that are incomplete, broken, or unreferenced.

faq.question: What is this skill for?
faq.answer: It helps developers create and improve Claude Code plugin skills with clear structure and effective trigger descriptions.

faq.question: Does it create runnable scripts?
faq.answer: It explains when scripts are useful, but the developer must provide or approve any script implementation.

faq.question: Can it review an existing skill?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides checklists for frontmatter, writing style, progressive disclosure, resource references, and testing.

faq.question: What tools does it support?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code compatibility for marketplace discovery.

faq.question: Why does it mention references and examples?
faq.answer: Those resources keep SKILL.md small while making detailed guidance available when needed.

faq.question: Is it safe to install?
faq.answer: The reviewed content is documentation-focused. Static alerts were caused by markdown examples and file path formatting.
